verdict.rationale: Scribe's documentation describes a diarization feature that identifies speakers from their speech characteristics and adds a speaker label to transcript segments, which is the core of the story. The evidence is a single brief line, so depth is unproven. Channel separation and RTMS participant details are separate features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: the request parameter and syntax for enabling diarization, the speaker-label output format, which modes (Fast/Batch/Live) support it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
